name: EPSG:1122 Arc 1960 to WGS 84 — blocked for survey-grade output

source.notes: EPSG:1122 is a geocentric translation from Arc 1960 (EPSG:4210) to WGS 84 (EPSG:4326). Its stated operation accuracy is 35 m; this is not a survey-grade transformation and the application blocks both directions pending a locally validated operation.
